aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: All primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The fields_to_schema dependency is the primary signal because schema load/dump behavior is highly sensitive to stale field and validator contracts.
The registry_to_nested dependency captures stale assumptions around schema class registration, declared fields, only/exclude propagation, and Nested resolution.
The decorators_to_schema dependency captures stale assumptions around hook metadata and error-store shape.
Revision v0.3.1 replaces an uncollectable MySchema method selector with the public, collected test_decorator_error_handling probe.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Field deserialize/serialize, validator, missing/default/null, and utility conversion contracts must be stable for Schema.load, Schema.dump, and Schema.validate.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when field/validator probes and schema validation/load probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The schema agent may implement load/dump around stale assumptions about field return values, error shapes, missing defaults, or validator exceptions.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Schema registration, declared-field collection, Meta options, and class-name lookup must support Nested fields, self references, and only/exclude propagation.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when registry/declaration probes and nested field/schema probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The field agent may implement Nested around stale registry or declared-field semantics, producing failures only after schema and nested tests integrate.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Decorator hook metadata, schema hook invocation, and ErrorStore merge semantics must agree with field and schema validation error contracts.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when decorator metadata, schema hook processing, field validation, and error-store probes pass together.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: Field or validation work may assume a stale hook metadata or error merge shape, causing integrated decorator/custom-error tests to fail.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves marshmallow field, registry, nested-schema, decorator, and error contracts.
